checks_published_virality_idx.name: checks_published_virality_idx

checks_published_requires_rating.name: checks_published_requires_rating

entitlements_one_subject.name: entitlements_one_subject
entitlements_one_subject.value: ("entitlements"."device_token_hash" IS NOT NULL) <> ("entitlements"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

submissions_url_or_text.name: submissions_url_or_text
submissions_url_or_text.value: ("submissions"."url" is not null and "submissions"."text" is null) or ("submissions"."url" is null and "submissions"."text" is not null)
